::: {#hero-heading}

I am a bioinformatics scientist and data scientist with expertise in genomics, epigenomics, and Bayesian statistics. My **research** focuses on collaborative bioinformatics and computational biology, working at the intersection of quantitative methods and biomedical research. My **work** emphasizes reproducibility, scalability, and effective communication with collaborators through modern computational infrastructure and open-source tools.

[Learn more about me &rarr;](/about){.about-links .subtitle}

:::
